info.title: Sprintful Universal API
info.description: Manage booking pages, availability, and bookings in Sprintful

get.description: Retrieves booking page availability from Sprintful.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The Sprintful booking page slug.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Availability window start date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

schema.description: Availability window start date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Availability window end date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

schema.description: Availability window end date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Sprintful availability for the requested page.

available.description: Whether the slot can be booked.

availableSeatsCount.description: Remaining seat count for the slot.

unavailableReason.description: Reason the slot is unavailable when Sprintful provides one.

appointments.description: Appointment types and their available slots.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves booking events available in Sprintful.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of bookings to return. Sprintful defaults to 50.

schema.description: Maximum number of bookings to return. Sprintful defaults to 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of bookings to skip before returning results.

schema.description: Number of bookings to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter bookings starting on or after this date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

schema.description: Filter bookings starting on or after this date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter bookings ending on or before this date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

schema.description: Filter bookings ending on or before this date. Sprintful format: DD-MM-YYY.

parameters.name: pageSlug
parameters.description: Only return bookings for a specific page slug.

parameters.name: excludePageSlug
parameters.description: Exclude bookings for a specific page slug.
